text_block_list.text:
A new year marked the start of the Senior Year.
I went for the first shrine visit of the year together with Cheval Grand.
At the meeting spot, Cheval Grand and her childhood friend, Shine Praise, are both present.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Umm...,
Happy New Year, Cheval-chan.
And to your Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Happy New Year, Shine...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, being so formal makes me blush.
C'mon... let's go make our shrine visit quickly!

The three of them visited the shrine and prayed for
Cheval Grand's success in the Senior class—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Cheval-chan.
What kind of wish did you make?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A wish, or rather... maybe a vow.
...That I'll win the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: So that I can hold my head high in the Tenno Sho (Spring)... and challenge Kita-san.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
...!
The Hanshin Daishoten, and the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's where... I want to see for myself.
My... the strength that only I possess.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Learn, discern.
Polish yourself, become stronger.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: In order to become... a "great Umamusume"...!

Hearing Cheval Grand speak with such conviction, I couldn't help but smile, seeing how much she'd grown.
Then, Shine Praise—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...Fufu, that feels somewhat—fateful.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: You see, Cheval-chan... I was thinking of entering them too. The Hanshin Daishoten, and the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time we've ever promised
to run in the same race in the Twinkle Series,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time since our debut……
that we're becoming "rivals," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Shine is my rival...
The girl who debuted a year before me...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Since we were little, Shine has always... walked ahead of me, gently holding my hand—and now, am I really going to fight her?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(—No.
No, that's it... That's exactly why...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, okay.
...Let's race, ...Shine.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want to know your true strength too...
And holding that up as a mirror—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because even I... want to find
more of my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
...I won't lose, Cheval-chan.
Watching the two of them exchange quiet yet passionate glances, I felt renewed motivation for the Hanshin Daishoten...

"And then, after seeing off Shine Praise,
who was scheduled to return to the academy first."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... So.
What... should we do now...?

Cheval Grand shoots me an inquisitive look.
Come to think of it, we haven't decided
what to do next.

We could head straight back to the academy, but
since we're already out, I'd like to enjoy
ourselves a bit before returning.
If I'm going to spend time with Cheval Grand—
choice_data_list: Shall we have some tea before heading back?
Well then, let's go get some exercise!
Can we stop by the bookstore?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...!
I was just getting thirsty myself—
(Grrrrrrrr~~~...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Ugh...
It might not just be my throat...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Jeez, why did it have to be right at this moment...!
I decided to head to a nearby cafe with Cheval Grand, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, you're right.
It's beautiful... Is this a violin?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now—abbandono!
Raise your glasses in a toast—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Walk-ins are more than welcome!
Let us celebrate the New Year together with exquisite musica!

At the center of the circle was Sounds of Earth,
who is well known at Tracen Academy
for his musical talents.

The audience is completely enchanted by the flowing tones of the violin.
Even the open-air café, normally quiet in the winter,
is packed with bustling customers today.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "Even though it's so cold, out there in the open... And yet... they look like they're having so much fun..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... Is no one here?
Where is the amore who will play
a passionate melodia with me—"
—If that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to join in as well♪
I can borrow the keyboard from the shop, right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A due! Of course you're more than welcome!
Come on, everyone! Feel free to clap along—

When I looked beside me to ask "What do you want to do?",
Cheval Grand was vigorously shaking her head.
However—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that Cheval over there?
Come on over! You should join in the fun too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Con amore!
Let us play the musica of our love!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!?
M-M-Me too...!?
The two of them spotted us without any trouble. Calming down a panicking Cheval Grand, I joined in the circle of New Year celebrations.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. Um, then...
Shall we head to the academy gym...?

That sounds nice too,
but since we're here, I'd like a change of pace from the usual.
So, what I came up with was—
choice_data_list: Wasn't there a batting cage nearby?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, true. Above the game center—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
They said I could challenge a 150 km/h pitch...
I've actually wanted to try that for a while...!

It was just an off-the-cuff suggestion, but it was surprisingly well received.
We immediately headed over to the batting cages, and—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah!!
Hey, it's Chevachi! What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Cheval.
...Did you come to hit a few balls, too?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: It feels nostalgic, just like when we were kids. Though at some point, you stopped hanging out with me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's nothing...
It's just that my schedule didn't work out, that's all..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, does that mean you're free today?
Let's have a showdown for the first time in a while♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...No, as for me—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, I lost the last time
we played together, but...
I've grown a lot bigger since then, you know!♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure,
I'm gonna beat Cheval-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds like that's how fired up she is, anyway.
What are you gonna do, Cheval? Run away from the fight?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading into the batter's box first.
Seeing her state it with such firm conviction made me appreciate her growth once more—though that moment was fleeting.
*KRAAAACK!!*

"...Faced with such an extraordinarily high-level battle
between sisters, I could only stand there completely dumbfounded."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A bookstore...?
choice_data_list: I wanted a book on how to clean fish.

text_block_list.text:
One of Cheval Grand's hobbies is fishing.
As her trainer, I thought it would be great to find
more ways we could enjoy it together.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, th-that... I think I might want to learn it too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
At home, I leave everything to the housekeeper...
I always felt bad about it, so—
And so, extending our stroll to the shopping mall, the bookstore was bustling with customers despite it being New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Well then, I'll go check that shelf over there—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………Found it……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san, what about this one—
...Wait.
(—Thud)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm s-so sorry.
I wasn't, um... paying attention to my surroundings... So—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No problem. I was careless as well.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Duramente-san...

The person Cheval Grand bumped into was none other
than Duramente, who had been taking time off
to recuperate from an injury since spring.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
U-U-Umm, yes, the fish...—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...You're not interested in... fish,
are you, Duramente-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Fish is good. It's packed with protein and other nutrients essential for an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Things that should be actively consumed.
...I think that's a good mindset.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......I got... praised.
